item.title: Italy approves antisemitism law amid leftist opposition protests
item.description:
By Angelo Amante

ROME, Nov 18 (Reuters) - Italy's parliament has given final approval to a bill aimed at combating antisemitism, which includes a contentious definition critics say could limit freedom of expression and advocacy for Palestinian rights.

The legislation, which the lower house adopted late on Tuesday by 147 votes to 93, enshrines the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA) definition of antisemitism, which lists some forms of criticism of Israel as examples of antisemitic conduct.

item.title: Iran attacks US bases in Gulf countries despite diplomatic efforts
item.description:
By Enas Alashray

Nov 18 (Reuters) - Gulf countries said on Wednesday they intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen, after the United States had struckQeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz in an uptick of hostilities despite efforts to end the nine-month-old war.

The back-and-forth attacks were a reminder of the hurdles facingdiplomatic efforts to end a war that has destabilised the Middle East, pushed up global energy prices and helped fuel the US voter anger that punished President Donald Trump's Republican Party in the November elections.

item.title: Gulf nations attacked after US strikes Iranian island
item.description:
Bahrain and Kuwait said Wednesday that they had repelled air attacks launched against them following US strikes on an Iranian island, as Gulf nations face retaliatory bombardment in the Middle East war.

The conflict -- which began with US-Israeli strikes on Iran in late February -- has spilled over to Gulf states that host US military facilities.

item.title: Pakistani man convicted of plotting to kill Trump is sentenced to over 27 years in prison
item.description:
By Kanishka Singh

WASHINGTON, Nov 17 (Reuters) - A US judge sentenced a Pakistani man to more than 27 years in prison for plotting in 2024 to kill President Donald Trump and other prominent US politicians at the behest of Iran, the Department of Justice said on Tuesday.

"Earlier today, in federal court in Brooklyn, Asif Merchant, 48, of Pakistan, was sentenced by US District Judge Eric RKomitee to 330 months in prison for attempting to commit an act of terrorism transcending national boundaries and murder for hire," the DOJ said in a statement.

item.title: Australia sanctions Israeli settlers, organisations over West Bank expansion
item.description:
By Renju Jose

SYDNEY, Nov 18 (Reuters) - Australia on Wednesday imposed sanctions on three Israeli individuals and four organisations for illegal settlement expansion and settler violence in the West Bank, saying those actions were extinguishing the possibility of a two-state solution.

Australia's move follows the United Kingdom's decision on Tuesday to sanction eight Israeli construction companies involved in building settlements in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Israeli parliament elects speaker backed by Netanyahu opponents
item.description:
JERUSALEM, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Israel's parliament voted on Tuesday to select a new speaker opposed to the agenda of Benjamin Netanyahu, a potential first step in rolling back theprime minister's divisive political agenda even as his main rival struggles to form a government.

Parties led by Gadi Eisenkot, Netanyahu's main competitor in an inconclusive October election, voted to install Matan Kahana, a member of Eisenkot's centre-right Yashar party, with 66 voting in favor of Kahana and 52 voting for another candidate, according to the office of the spokesperson for the parliament.

item.title: Israel parliament elects Eisenkot ally as speaker in blow for Netanyahu
item.description:
Israeli lawmakers on Tuesday elected a parliament speaker from the camp opposed to caretaker prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu, a first step towards rolling back the legacy of the country's divisive veteran leader.

Sixty six lawmakers out of 120 voted in favour of Matan Kahana, an ally of former military chief Gadi Eisenkot who has until next month to form a government to replace Netanyahu.

Netanyahu's Likud party had put forward Ofir Katz as its own candidate, who received 52 votes.

item.title: At hearing, US Navy chief blasted over Iran war and its toll on sailors
item.description:
By Phil Stewart and Patricia Zengerle

WASHINGTON, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Democratic lawmakers tore into President Donald Trump's acting head of the Navy on Tuesday, accusing him of being a Trump "yes man" on the Iran war and downplaying its toll on sailors' mental health after eight suicide attempts on an aircraft carrier.

The contentious hearing during the waning days of the Republican-led Senate could be a preview of what's to come when Democrats take control in January after victories in midterm elections earlier this month.

item.title: US-Israeli war created 'horrific' situation for Iranians: Amnesty
item.description:
Iranian authorities have intensified their repression of the country's population in response to the Middle East war, which began weeks after their deadly crackdown on anti-government protests killed thousands of people, Amnesty International said on Tuesday.

An internet blackout imposed at the time of the crackdown on January 8 and 9 and the scale of the casualties meant it was not yet possible for the group to quantify the number of people killed, Amnesty's lead Iran researcher, Raha Bahreini, said.

item.title: Israel vows retaliation after UK sanctions firms for West Bank settlements
item.description:
Britain on Tuesday unveiled sanctions against eight Israeli companies involved in planning and building West Bank settlements, drawing a sharp warning that Israel would hit back.

The new measures, aimed at hindering expansion of the settlements, which are considered illegal under international law, also follow what the UK government has called a reset of its approach to the issue in September.

item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with officials from Oman and Qatar as Washington and Tehran exchanged fresh strikes.
